semiconductor_relevance: High — Foshan Goldstone Technology specializes in advanced carbon and graphite materials that are critical for various semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Foshan Goldstone Technology Co., Ltd. is a national high-tech enterprise focused on the R&D, production, and application of carbon fiber insulating materials and carbon-carbon composite materials. Their products are utilized in the semiconductor industry for high-temperature applications and thermal management solutions.

regional_presence.China: The company has established partnerships with several Chinese universities and research institutions.
